description.zh: 用户的应用ID，在控制台创建应用时生成。包含小写字母、数字，长度为6个字符。
description.en: The application ID of the user, generated when the application is created in the console. The ID contains lowercase letters and digits and is 6 characters in length.
The unique identifier of the class.

description.zh: 操作者用户ID，仅支持英文和数字，最大长度36个字符。
description.en: The user ID of the operator. Only letters and digits are supported. Maximum length: 36 characters.
